content.text: I added a completion checkbox to each todo and All / Active / Completed filter buttons, with All selected on load. Completed todos sort below active ones, and each group stays oldest first; the ordering is applied only when the list is drawn, so unchecking a todo puts it back where it was. I only syntax-checked the script; I didn't open the page in a browser. Todos saved before this change load as active, and the chosen filter resets on reload.
